complainant_name.title: Complainant Name
complainant_name.description: Confirm it with the person at the desk before telling them anything

contact_name.title: Contact Name
contact_name.description: The contact person named at the acknowledgement; null before it

answer_due.title: Answer Due
answer_due.description: The date the complainant was given for the outcome, with any extension; null before the acknowledgement

appeal_until.title: Appeal Until
appeal_until.description: The last day to appeal, once the outcome is conveyed

can_appeal.title: Can Appeal
can_appeal.description: Take the appeal now (POST /complaints/{complaint_id}/appeal): Resolved, within the window, and the caller takes complaints

can_open.title: Can Open
can_open.description: GET /complaints/{complaint_id} opens it for the caller: a complaint reader or manager, the person who received it, its investigator or the desk that took its appeal

ComplaintCardOut.title: ComplaintCardOut
ComplaintCardOut.description:
What any complaint desk reads by the exact tracking number the complainant brings (decision 63): how the complaint
stands and whether it can be appealed now; never what it says, the patient, the findings or the outcome.
